planets.name: TOI-2000 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2000 with a 3.1-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-2000 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-2000. Its orbit and size follow Sha et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
